text:
An electric motor is connected to the mains supply by insulated wires. The circuit is protected by
a fuse, but the connecting wires become hot.
insulated connecting wire
live
M
motor
neutral
insulated connecting wire
How could the wires be prevented from becoming so hot?
A
Connect a second fuse in the neutral wire.
B
Use a fuse with a higher current rating.
C
Use thicker connecting wires.
D
Use thicker insulation on the connecting wires.

options.label: A
options.text: Connect a second fuse in the neutral wire.

options.label: B
options.text: Use a fuse with a higher current rating.

options.label: D
options.text: Use thicker insulation on the connecting wires.
